metadata.name: Shadow & Light Slider
metadata.description: A full-screen slider of dark gallery scenes: a flashlight follows the cursor and relights marble busts, layers move in depth and serif headlines change per slide. Built in Slider Revolution's visual editor; make it yours with a free SR Anywhere account and pass your embed key.
